_about: Everything the characters say to the player, and who says it. character is an id from data/characters.json (ginger, admiral, pilot, mechanic, scientist). Edit the text freely; keep {placeholders} as they are.
_tips: Shown one at a time, in this order, while the condition in 'when' holds (conditions are named in game/tips.gd). The phase clock holds while a tip is up. anchor dims the screen around a control and points an arrow at it; arrow only points the arrow, without dimming. Both take: timer, tool:<building> for a toolbar building button, button:<label> for a toolbar button by its label, weapons for the first weapon in targeting, hex:damaged for our first building waiting for repair, hex:targeted_launcher for the launcher the enemy keeps hitting, or hex:suspected_base for an enemy potential base with hits on it. Also toolbar, res:money, res:fuel, res:research, minimap, info, volume and status. arrows: a list of [where, seconds] for an arrow that moves along while the tip is up (each entry from that many seconds after it appears). from_round holds a tip back until that round. pause also blocks clicks behind the tip until it is dismissed. {build_clock} is the player's build clock; other {placeholders} come from rules.json.

tips.text: General, let me walk you through the controls. Everything is fully automated: you can command all of our forces from right here.
On the left-hand side you'll find the toolbar. It holds the tools you need for each phase of the game.
In the top right is what we have on hand: our money, our fuel, and any research points. In parentheses next to each is how much of it we're producing every round.
This is the minimap. Use it to move around the map, and the buttons beneath it to rotate and zoom your view.
And this is the info panel. It reads out whatever's relevant to what you're doing as you move through the game.
Oh, and you can control the volume here... and track our bases' health here.
So now you've got the 411. Good luck out there, General. We're all counting on you.
General, place our bases carefully. If we lose all three, we lose the war. A decoy can help draw the enemy away from our real targets.

Very strategic choices, General! Now that our bases are in place, we need to place our offensive and defensive buildings. If you want to reposition any bases or decoys, now's the time. Hit undo to back up.
General, you have {build_clock} seconds every round to place your buildings. Make sure we're producing fuel and money, and of course wreak as much havoc on the enemy as you can.
Ah, General! Welcome to the research lab! Every lab adds research points each round, shown at the top. Spend them here, with a little money, and the research is ours at once. More labs, more points!
Careful, General! We've got some damage on the ground. Damaged buildings can be repaired for {repair_pct}% of their original cost.
General, they keep hitting the same launcher. Repairs won't hold while they're aiming at it. Build a new one somewhere they haven't seen.
General, the missile launcher is our first offensive weapon. Build one early so we can start hitting back and find out where the enemy's bases are before it's too late.
We need anti-air, General. Each one shoots at missiles aimed within {aa_radius} hexes of it, up to {aa_engagements} a round.
General, I'd research radar next. Anti-air inside a radar's range hits {acc_radar}% of the time instead of {acc}%. Build a lab, then select it or click its beaker to pick the research.

Looks like you're trying to land your troops on enemy territory, General. Click once on where you want them to land, then click on an adjacent hex to tell them which way to move once boots are on the ground.
Pick a weapon on the left, then click on the map to aim it. Expect to miss a few times as we clear the fog of war and learn the layout of their island.
We don't have the fuel to fire every launcher, General. Each refinery adds {refinery_fuel} fuel a round.

_announcements: Said at moments in the game. income is the report at the start of each round from round 2 (no Don't show this again box; the round clock runs underneath it). When the last round's attack had anything to report, the battle_report lines come first and income_after_report follows them in the same bubble; the round clock runs underneath it too. {money}, {fuel}, {research}, {n} are filled in when said. The incoming warning has no Don't show this again box either.

income.text: General, we took in {money} money, {fuel} fuel and {research} research.

incoming_one.text: General! An enemy missile is incoming!

incoming_troops.text: General! Enemy transport inbound! They're dropping troops on us!

incoming_boat.text: General! Enemy boat coming ashore! They're landing troops on our coast!

incoming_nuke.text: General! Nuclear missile incoming! Brace for impact!

level_3_intro.text: Well done, General. Our scientists have cracked the atom. Finish enough research and they can build us a nuclear silo. A nuke hits twice as hard as any missile and flattens everything around it, and anti-air will rarely stop one. Expect the enemy to be working on the same.

level_2_intro.text: Congratulations on your victory, General. As you have been fighting, our scientists have come up with a new type of base: a stronghold. It is impervious to air attack and comes with a mounted anti-aircraft missile on its roof. The only way it can be taken is with ground troops.

enemy_stronghold.text: General, bad news! Enemy spies have stolen the secrets of our stronghold tech and built one of their own. We're going to have to get some invasion forces ready to destroy it.

attack_unaimed.text: Don't forget to target your weapons before you click attack.
endings: Otherwise they'll run circles around us!
Otherwise they'll get a free shot!
Otherwise they'll get the upper hand!

first_base_lost.text: Oh no! We lost our first base!
endings: Two more and it's curtains for us.
Two more and we'll be finished! Finished, I tell you!
Two more and we'll be cooked!
Two more and it's the end of the road!

build_timeout.text: General - we have limited time to fortify our base each round before the enemy attacks. Make sure to keep an eye on the countdown timer!

no_weapons_confirm.text: General, we have no offensive weapons. Are you sure you want to advance to the attack phase?

boat_spotted.text: General, an enemy boat is crossing the channel. It will come ashore on our coast when this round's attack plays out.

income_after_report.text: And we took in {money} money, {fuel} fuel and {research} research.

battle_report.text: General, I have the battle summary.
battle_report._parts: One line per thing that happened this round, in this order, skipped when it's zero. Each is [said for one, said for more]; {n} is the number. Soldiers are counted 8 to a platoon.

hit_us: One enemy missile got through to us.
{n} enemy missiles got through to us.
our_damaged: One of our buildings was damaged.
shot_down_by_us: Our anti-air shot down one of their missiles.
Our anti-air shot down {n} of their missiles.
transports_shot_down_by_us: We brought down one of their transports.
We brought down {n} of their transports.
hit_them: One of our missiles found its target.
{n} of our missiles found their targets.
our_shot_down: They shot down one of our missiles.
They shot down {n} of our missiles.
our_transports_shot_down: They shot down one of our transports.
They shot down {n} of our transports.
enemy_soldiers_lost: We stopped one of their soldiers.

announcements._endings: endings: one of these, picked at random each time, is said after the line.
